actions.name: Calculate and transform sourced mass properties
actions.purpose: Express properties consistently at body COM and target axes.
actions.inputs: Eligible geometry/density or supplied mass/COM/tensor, reference point/frame, unit conversion and rigid-group membership.
actions.outputs: Mass, COM and symmetric tensor with raw source values, method and transform receipt.
actions.accuracy: Tensor units mass×length²; density/volume uncertainty and integration error separate. OCCT integration error estimate is numerical method evidence, distinct from density/shape/measurement uncertainty; retain the epsilon/adaptive setting and source coordinate length powers.
actions.evidence: Selected integration algorithm/kernel version and frame/aggregation lineage.
actions.software: Source-backed candidate: OCCT 8.0.1 BRepGProp::VolumeProperties fills GProp_GProps with no-density volume integrals. Validate finite closed coherently oriented solids first. Record exact-surface versus UseTriangulation setting and integration-error method. Apply coherent material density once; GProp Mass may initially mean volume, CentreOfMass is absolute and MatrixOfInertia is central with axes parallel to absolute axes. Decode raw tensor order/sign/reference into a common symmetric matrix before shifts/rotations; GProp Add(component,density) can aggregate with parallel-axis shifts when frames/reference conventions match.
actions.agent: Review hollow/heterogeneous distribution and source assumptions; prevent counting repeated geometry twice.
actions.user_decisions: Choose supported density distribution or retain partial measurements.
actions.dependencies: Documented kernel mass-property API and selected format inertia convention; exact API discovery required.
actions.proposed_development: Proposal: physical-property adapter accepts measured fields or validated shapes/density plus raw component/sign/reference/unit metadata. It emits no-density geometric integrals, density application count, physical mass/COM/central tensor and frame/aggregation ledger. Length scaling uses volume L³, geometric inertia L⁵ and physical inertia mass×L²; mass/length/density units convert coherently. Reject an unknown source off-diagonal/product convention rather than copy field names.
procedure: Validate solid prerequisites or supplied measurement field conventions; decode tensor ordering/sign/reference into a common matrix and convert units.
For geometry, integrate no-density properties under recorded surface/triangulation/error settings and apply material density exactly once; preserve central tensor and absolute COM conventions.

Shift any noncentral source tensor to COM with stated direction, rotate each central tensor into target axes, aggregate via parallel-axis terms at a common origin and shift the aggregate to its weighted COM.
actions.validation: Compare mass/COM and tensor independently; use I_about_point = I_COM + m((d·d)Identity − d dᵀ) in one frame and I_rotated = R I Rᵀ; inverse shift subtracts that term.
actions.failure_resume: Invalid integration or uncertain reference retains source values; repair representation/frame only before recalculation.
actions.resources: Local analytic/solid integration before dense mesh integration; cost follows bodies/faces; remote review/manual density data separate.

common_protocol.status: All helper/interfaces/procedures/test cases are proposals. Current execution is document authoring/static review; original operation contracts and implementation plan remain unchanged. Acceptance labels require MARK AS ACCEPTED.
common_protocol.frames: Record source/target revisions, units, axes, handedness, matrix storage/application convention and direction p_target = T_target_source p_source. Separate unit scale, rigid placement, numerical-origin shift and CRS/map conversion. URDF uses ROS SI/right-handed conventions; MJCF units are selected consistently and compiler angle is explicit. Joint axis is expressed in the stated joint/body frame with type-specific meaning/limits. Compare named reference and moved states; a zero pose alone does not validate motion.
common_protocol.physical: Per rigid body, record source fields, component ordering, off-diagonal matrix versus product-of-inertia sign convention, tensor reference point/axes and units. Decode to a common symmetric matrix before shift/rotation. Mass, COM and tensor completeness are independent. Geometry branch validates finite closed coherent solids before BRepGProp VolumeProperties; its no-density volume/inertia integrals require coherent length powers and density exactly once. GProp COM is absolute and tensor central/parallel to absolute axes. Rotate central tensor, shift to common aggregation origin, sum and shift to weighted COM; record each step and uncertainty. Numerical symmetry/eigenvalue/triangle checks, integration error and physical measurements remain distinct.
common_protocol.geometry_roles: Occurrence, rigid body, visual asset, collision piece and mass-distribution geometry have separate IDs/roles even when coincident. Required contacts/passages compare feature geometry and named target fixtures. MuJoCo compiler recenter/principal-axis processing retains raw asset frame, mesh_scale, mesh_pos/mesh_quat and geom/body/world composition; compare effective placed surfaces. Explicit/defaulted inertia inference and collision filters are part of model provenance.
common_protocol.building: IFC schema/context/units, spatial hierarchy/containment, element/type/occurrence identities, placements, host/void/filling relations and CRS/map/datum sources remain separate. Triangle, B-rep and display derivatives retain source mapping and actual opening/unit/local/world settings. A geometric hole differs from a semantic opening record. Source example converted IDs retain their namespace. GLB identity is an actual many-to-many element/node/primitive/occurrence relation, with separately checked CLI sidecar or serializer GUID policy.
common_protocol.accuracy: For each feature/relationship/physical quantity record intended use, source engineering allowance, source/measurement uncertainty, geometric approximation/integration/solver threshold and numerical/readback comparison threshold separately. No invented dimensions, material density, wall thickness, joint limit or universal error score. Readiness names downstream consumer and required role/feature.
common_protocol.branches: Each branch records input/source subset and digests, intended use, component/feature coverage, representation/detail, per-feature criteria, units/frame, exact requested model/effort and exposed actual identity. Ambiguous source interpretation can use higher reasoning effort; explicit checked inputs support software paths. VLM receives original full views and located crops with coordinate/source mapping, source fields and actual query receipts. It selects source-supported associations or complete candidates, or combines compatible fields with provenance; new design choices remain user decisions. Preserve contradictory semantics/dimensions rather than average them.
common_protocol.review: A separate semantic reviewer execution receives original sources, candidate/merge revision, mappings, source-linked views and numerical findings. Record producer/merger/reviewer identities and shared dependencies. Numerical checks identify actual saved artifact, reader/kernel, controls and criteria. Compile/schema/parse success, source correspondence, physical agreement and model agreement have separate evidence.
common_protocol.merge: Selected branch fields/assets produce a new revision with explicit lineage. Recheck required geometry, identities/graph/relationships, frame/units, physical properties and exact saved/compiled consumer artifact; repeat dependent contact/closure fixtures where applicable. Preserve source evidence and rejected candidates.
common_protocol.resources: Start with metadata, graph/units and required interfaces before dense tessellation, whole-building extraction or contact evaluation. Local CPU/RAM/GPU estimates state input element/face/link/hull counts, detail and algorithm settings; estimates are qualitative until actual run records exist. Remote model calls/tokens/latency/cost and manual interpretation/metrology/recipient effort are separate. Parallel candidate analysis uses isolated revisions/settings; computational jobs obey current authorization.
common_protocol.failure_resume: Retain input hashes, action/request IDs, native/spec/file revision, output hashes, diagnostics and last validated boundary. For uncertain native mutation/serialization, inspect document/entity/output state before retry to avoid duplicate occurrences. For interrupted/uncertain remote VLM calls, retain prompt/input/source digests, request/response identity, raw/partial reply and retry lineage; reconcile completion where available, validate required selection rows before any merge. Malformed response or partial sidecar/XML cannot change published artifact. Recheck source digests on resume; invalidate affected descendants only, including physics after geometry/material edits and scenes/colliders after IFC placement/opening changes.
common_protocol.migration: Per action/input class, implement proposed helpers only under separately authorized scope after fixture expected results exist. Compare against checked agent-led cases and independent sources; automate demonstrated ordinary cases with explicit exception route. Preserve source/capability/version evidence and actual execution results separately.
